description: This file contains abstract and concrete classes that implement grain call filters for the Orleans framework, specifically for propagating activity correlation information (distributed traces) across asynchronous grain calls. It defines mechanisms for extracting and injecting trace context using ActivitySource and OpenTelemetry conventions.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationGrainCallFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class providing utility methods for propagating activity context in grain calls, including handling activity sources and processing activities around call invocation.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationOutgoingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the outbound grain call filter which injects trace context into outgoing requests, utilizing a distributed context propagator.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationIncomingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the inbound grain call filter which extracts trace context from incoming requests and creates corresponding activity spans.

methods.name: GetActivitySource
methods.description: Determines whether to use the runtime or application activity source based on the interface type namespace.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles setting activity tags, exception handling, and stopping the activity during grain call execution.
